hydraflight.name: Hydra Flight
hydraflight.desc: Full local Levitate, Hydra Bond and Berserk. Surviving a move that crosses half HP grants +1 Attack and Sp. Atk; Dragon’s Den entry grants +2 to both. Ground immunity can be bypassed normally; Hydra Bond remains active. Eligible attacks hit three times with the existing later-hit, spread, Free-for-All and Gilded Helix rules. Retains Dragon’s Den power boost.

worldbreaker.name: Worldbreaker
worldbreaker.shortDesc: Merciless + Duskilate; each damaging hit has a 30% chance of double power.
worldbreaker.desc: Merciless + Duskilate. Each damaging hit independently has a 30% chance to double its base power.

falseliberation.name: False Liberation
falseliberation.shortDesc: Mold Breaker; once per entry, a Dark HP hit inflicts Torment.
falseliberation.desc: Mold Breaker. Once per entry, Dark damage to a foe’s HP inflicts Torment. Only a newly applied Torment spends the use; existing Torment is not refreshed.
